links.outcome: Performance of melanoma models on new early-stage dataset versus ISIC training-domain datasets
links.effect: Significant performance drop on the new early-stage melanoma dataset compared with results on ISIC Challenge datasets; limited capability to detect early-stage melanoma. No numbers in abstract.
links.quote: We evaluated several state-of-the-art deep learning models on this dataset and observed a significant drop in performance compared to their results on the ISIC Challenge datasets.

unlisted_practices: Report melanoma stage/T-category (Breslow thickness) distribution of training data and benchmark on early-stage lesions

screen.reason: The study introduces a benchmark dataset specifically addressing early-stage melanoma (stratified by Breslow thickness) and evaluates the generalization and performance drops of existing state-of-the-art diagnostic deep learning models across datasets.
